remarks: Nestled in a peaceful neighborhood, this inviting new Cape Cod listing blends timeless charm with modern comfort. The home features four spacious bedrooms and two updated baths, offering plenty of room for everyday living or welcoming guests. The cozy main living room provides a warm, welcoming atmosphere with a comfortable layout  The updated well-designed eat-in kitchen is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, featuring modern finishes, ample cabinetry, and generous counter space. Thoughtful upgrades enhance functionality while maintaining a clean, timeless look, making this kitchen a welcoming hub of the home which opens to a private backyard-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. A spacious basement offers abundant storage and versatile functionality, with the potential to be finished for additional living space.  With its traditional style and welcoming layout, this Cape Cod home delivers comfort, character, and convenience. The home is conveniently located close to the high school, downtown train, and shopping, making daily errands and commuting a breeze. With its charming feel and unbeatable location, this property is an ideal choice for buyers seeking both comfort and convenience. With its timeless design and inviting layout, this Cape Cod gem is ready to welcome you home.
